_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "lang" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "license" TEXT NOT NULL, "license_url" TEXT NULL, "license_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "attribution" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "commercial_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "surah" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name_ar" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_translit" TEXT NOT NULL, "revelation_place" TEXT NOT NULL, "revelation_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ayah_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bismillah_pre" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("bismillah_pre" IN (0, 1)), "bismillah_uthmani" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "surah_text" ("surah_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES surah (id), "lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_meaning" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("surah_id", "lang"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ayah" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "surah_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES surah (id), "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "text_uthmani" TEXT NOT NULL, "text_simple" TEXT NOT NULL, "juz" INTEGER NOT NULL, "hizb_quarter" INTEGER NOT NULL, "page" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sajda" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), "simple_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("surah_id", "number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "translation" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ayah_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ayah (id), "lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), "text" TEXT NOT NULL, "footnotes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("ayah_id", "lang", "source_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lemma" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "text_ar" TEXT NOT NULL, "translit" TEXT NULL, "root" TEXT NULL, "frequency" INTEGER NULL, "rank" INTEGER NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lemma_meaning" ("lemma_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES lemma (id), "lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "meaning" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("lemma_id", "lang"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "word" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ayah_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ayah (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "text_ar" TEXT NOT NULL, "translit" TEXT NULL, "lemma_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES lemma (id), "char_start" INTEGER NULL, "char_end" INTEGER NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("ayah_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "word_meaning" ("word_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES word (id), "lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "meaning" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("word_id", "lang"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hadith" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "collection" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" TEXT NULL, "text_ar" TEXT NOT NULL, "intro_ar" TEXT NULL, "narrator_ar" TEXT NULL, "grade" TEXT NOT NULL, "grade_ar" TEXT NOT NULL, "tags" TEXT NULL, "categories" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hadith_text" ("hadith_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hadith (id), "lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "text" TEXT NOT NULL, "intro" TEXT NULL, "narrator" TEXT NULL, "attribution" TEXT NOT NULL, "grade_label" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("hadith_id", "lang"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dua" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "text_ar" TEXT NOT NULL, "translit" TEXT NULL, "repeat_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "time_of_day" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'any', "source_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), "reviewed_by" TEXT NULL, "reviewed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dua_text" ("dua_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dua (id), "lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "text" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("dua_id", "lang"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "name_of_allah" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "text_ar" TEXT NOT NULL, "translit" TEXT NULL, "ref_ayah_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES ayah (id), "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "name_text" ("name_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES name_of_allah (id), "lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "meaning" TEXT NOT NULL, "short_note" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("name_id", "lang"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reflection" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL, "facets_json" TEXT NULL, "anchor_json" TEXT NULL, "season" TEXT NULL, "reviewed_by" TEXT NULL, "reviewed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reflection_text" ("reflection_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reflection (id), "lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "text" TEXT NOT NULL, "question" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("reflection_id", "lang"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quest_template" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL, "facets_json" TEXT NULL, "evidence_json" TEXT NULL, "weight" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "cooldown_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 21, "reviewed_by" TEXT NULL, "reviewed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quest_text" ("quest_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES quest_template (id), "lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("quest_id", "lang"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "islamic_event" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rule_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "quest_overrides_json" TEXT NULL, "card_overrides_json" TEXT NULL, "tests_json" TEXT NULL, "reviewed_by" TEXT NULL, "reviewed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "islamic_event_text" ("event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES islamic_event (id), "lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("event_id", "lang"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "intro_card" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES islamic_event (id), "reviewed_by" TEXT NULL, "reviewed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "intro_card_text" ("intro_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES intro_card (id), "lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("intro_id", "lang"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "country" ("iso2" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("iso2"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "city" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "ascii_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "country_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES country (iso2), "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lng" REAL NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "population" INTEGER NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
